patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I was winning until I landed wrong and rolled my ankle. It hurts when I stand on it. Do I at least get cool crutches?
presentation.triageNote: 10-year-old boy with localized ankle swelling and pain after rolling it while playing tennis. Weight-bearing is painful; distal pulse, movement, and sensation are intact.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because the patient is stable and is expected to require one resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a stable patient with an isolated ankle injury who is expected to need one diagnostic resource.
clinical.acuityReason: There is no immediate life threat, high-risk feature, severe distress, deformity, or neurovascular compromise in the information presented.
keyFindings: Intact distal circulation, movement, and sensation
teachingPoints: Triage decisions consider both current acuity and the resources likely to be needed, rather than relying on a final diagnosis.
This otherwise stable injury is expected to need a focused imaging evaluation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: An ankle X-ray would likely be followed by supportive treatment, possible splinting, and discharge with return precautions if no unstable injury is identified.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' contains source information for recreating the patient artwork. It is administrative and is never displayed to the player.
aiImageGeneration.who: 10-year-old boy in white tennis kit, racket beside him
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting on a clinic chair, one shoe off
signs: right ankle visibly swollen and red

Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 10-year-old boy who looks his age (lean and athletic), in a white tennis outfit with a white wrist sweatband, a tennis racket propped beside him, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with arms crossed, one shoe off. Expression: an annoyed, cocky brave-face wince - one eye squinted shut, brow furrowed, mouth in a gritted half-grimace showing a bit of teeth, a tough kid toughing it out (NOT crying, NOT a soft happy smile). Clearly visible: a localized red, inflamed swelling ONLY around the right ankle joint - a red puffy patch right at the ankle bone, with the rest of the bare foot, toes, and leg a normal skin tone (bare foot, no sock, no bandage). No text, no logos.
